places.label: Count Check — Lumbridge, south of the church: teleports to the Stronghold of Security

steps: The fastest way: talk to Count Check in the Lumbridge graveyard, south of the church: Talk-to, "Where can I learn more about security?", "Yes". He teleports you for free straight to the entrance, but only once and only if you have never been to the Stronghold.

Without the teleport: a canoe at Woodcutting 12-26 takes you from Lumbridge only as far as Champions' Guild (1 stop), then walk north-west along the river, about 2 minutes. At Woodcutting 27 the canoe goes straight to Barbarian Village.
Find the hole (Entrance) in the middle of the village by the mine and climb down.
Turn on run (the boot icon by the minimap) and do not attack the monsters: run from door to door.

The doors come in pairs. Between them is an empty corridor where nobody hits you: eat and recover here. At the second door there is sometimes a security question: the right answer is always that you never share your password, PIN or codes and do not trust links in chat.
Floor 1 (Vault of War): at the end open Gift of Peace for 2,000 coins. Then take the ladder down.
Floor 2 (Catacomb of Famine): the monsters are aggressive here, so do not linger. At the end open Grain of Plenty for 3,000 coins.
Floor 3 (Pit of Pestilence): open the Box of Health for 5,000 coins and a full health restore.
Floor 4 (Sepulchre of Death): open the Cradle of Life and choose Fighting boots or Fancy boots.

The way out is the home teleport: Magic tab, Lumbridge Home Teleport (the first icon), and do not press anything for about 14 seconds. It is free, once every 30 minutes; if the icon is grey the teleport is recharging, so go back by the ladders (Climb-up).

steps: Talk to Hassan in the Al Kharid Palace. Dialogue: “Is there anything I can help you with?” → “Yes”.
Talk to Osman north of the Al Kharid Palace.

Have Ned in Draynor Village make you a wig from 3 balls of wool. He also sells rope: 15 coins via dialogue, 18 coins from his shop, or 4 balls of wool. Dialogue: “Could you make other things apart from rope?” → “How about some sort of wig?” → “I have them here. Please make me a wig”.
Dye the wig with yellow dye. If you need a yellow dye, Aggie in Draynor Village makes one from two onions and 5 coins.
Talk to Aggie in Draynor Village to get some paste. She needs ashes, redberries, a pot of flour and a bucket of water. Dialogue: “Can you make skin paste?” → “Yes please. Mix me some skin paste”.

Talk to Lady Keli in the jail east of Draynor Village and take a print of the key: use soft clay on the key. If you have already made the print, open the quest journal to re-sync. Dialogue: “Heard of you? You're famous in Gielinor!” → “What's your latest plan then?” → “How do you know someone won't try to free him?” → “Could I see the key please?” → “Could I touch the key for a moment please?”.
Use the key print on any furnace with a bronze bar in your inventory to make a bronze key (the nearest furnace is in Lumbridge).
Talk to Leela east of Draynor Village.
The level 26 jail guards inside the jail attack on sight and hit up to 3: walk past them, the quest does not need them dead.
Bring everything to the jail and give Joe three beers. Dialogue: “I have some beer here. Fancy one?”.
Use the rope on Lady Keli to tie her up.
Use the key on the prison door. If Lady Keli respawned you will need to tie her up again.
Talk to Prince Ali and free him (wear the wig, skirt and paste).
Return to Hassan in the Al Kharid Palace to complete the quest.

steps: Talk to Reldo in the Varrock Palace library. Dialogue: “I'm in search of a quest.” → “Yes.”.
Search the marked bookcase in the library for the book, then read it (left-click the book in your inventory).
Talk to Reldo again. Dialogue: “Okay, I've read that book about the Shield of Arrav.”.
You and a partner join different gangs: one the Phoenix Gang, the other the Black Arm Gang. You cannot change later. The chat channel “OSRS SOA” finds a partner.
Talk to Baraek in Varrock Square: ask about the Phoenix Gang, not furs. Dialogue: “Can you tell me where I can find the Phoenix Gang?” → “Okay. Have 20 gold coins.”.
Climb down the ladder into the Phoenix Gang hideout in south-east Varrock and talk to Straven. Dialogue: “I know who you are!” → “I'd like to offer you my services.”.
Kill Jonny the Beard (level 2) in the Blue Moon Inn and pick up the Intel report.
Give the Intel report to Straven in the hideout: he gives you the Weapon store key.
Search the chest in the hideout for half of the Shield of Arrav.
Talk to Charlie the Tramp at the south entrance of Varrock. Dialogue: “Is there anything down this alleyway?” → “I'm looking for the Black Arm Gang.” → “Do you think they would let me join?”.
Talk to Katrine down the alley to the west and join her gang. Dialogue: “I want to become a member of your gang.” → “Well, you can give me a try can't you?” → “Ok, no problem.”.
Get the Weapon store key from your Phoenix Gang partner, climb the ladder into the weapon storeroom in south-east Varrock, kill the Weaponsmaster (level 23) and pick up both Phoenix crossbows.
Bring both crossbows to Katrine, go up the stairs in the gang base and search the cupboard for half of the Shield of Arrav.
Pass the Weapon store key to your partner, then take your half of the shield to Curator Haig Halen in the Varrock Museum: he gives you half of a certificate.
Swap certificate halves with a player of the other gang (a partner or a second account; alone, skip the quest: it is optional) and use the two halves together.
Give the Certificate to King Roald in Varrock Palace to finish the quest.

steps: Talk to Reldo in the Varrock Palace library. Dialogue: “I'm in search of a quest.” → “Yes.”.
Search the marked bookcase in the library for the book, then read it (left-click the book in your inventory).
Talk to Reldo again. Dialogue: “Okay, I've read that book about the Shield of Arrav.”.
You and a partner join different gangs: one the Phoenix Gang, the other the Black Arm Gang. You cannot change later. The chat channel “OSRS SOA” finds a partner.
Talk to Baraek in Varrock Square: ask about the Phoenix Gang, not furs. Dialogue: “Can you tell me where I can find the Phoenix Gang?” → “Okay. Have 20 gold coins.”.
Climb down the ladder into the Phoenix Gang hideout in south-east Varrock and talk to Straven. Dialogue: “I know who you are!” → “I'd like to offer you my services.”.
Kill Jonny the Beard (level 2) in the Blue Moon Inn and pick up the Intel report.
Give the Intel report to Straven in the hideout: he gives you the Weapon store key.
Search the chest in the hideout for half of the Shield of Arrav.
Talk to Charlie the Tramp at the south entrance of Varrock. Dialogue: “Is there anything down this alleyway?” → “I'm looking for the Black Arm Gang.” → “Do you think they would let me join?”.
Talk to Katrine down the alley to the west and join her gang. Dialogue: “I want to become a member of your gang.” → “Well, you can give me a try can't you?” → “Ok, no problem.”.
Get the Weapon store key from your Phoenix Gang partner, climb the ladder into the weapon storeroom in south-east Varrock, kill the Weaponsmaster (level 23) and pick up both Phoenix crossbows.
Bring both crossbows to Katrine, go up the stairs in the gang base and search the cupboard for half of the Shield of Arrav.
Pass the Weapon store key to your partner, then take your half of the shield to Curator Haig Halen in the Varrock Museum: he gives you half of a certificate.
Swap certificate halves with a player of the other gang (a partner or a second account; alone, skip the quest: it is optional) and use the two halves together.
Give the Certificate to King Roald in Varrock Palace to finish the quest.

steps: Talk to King Narnode Shareen in the Grand Tree (make sure to have two empty inventory slots to start the quest). Dialogue: “You seem worried, what's up?” → “I'd be happy to help!”.
Go up to Hazelmere, on the island east of Yanille: on foot from Yanille (the fairy ring CLS opens only after Fairytale II, step S9-03).
Talk to Hazelmere; he takes the bark sample and gives you a message for the king.

Return to King Narnode in the Grand Tree and pass on the message. Dialogue: “I think so!” → “A man came to me with the King's seal” → “I gave the man Daconia rocks” → “And Daconia rocks will kill the tree!”.
Go up to Glough in the Tree Gnome Stronghold.
Talk to Glough.
Talk to King Narnode again in the Grand Tree.
Talk to Charlie on the top floor of the Grand Tree.
Return to Charlie.
Return to Glough's house and search the cupboard for Glough's journal.
Talk to Glough about his journal; you get arrested.
Talk to Charlie in the cell.
Talk to King Narnode outside Charlie's cell.
Travel with the glider (at the top of the tree) to Karamja to escape. Dialogue: “Take me to Karamja please!”.
Enter the shipyard on Karamja: say Glough sent you and give the password Ka-Lu-Min. Dialogue: “Glough sent me” → “Ka” → “Lu” → “Min”.

Get the lumber order from the Foreman on the southern docks. You can either kill him or talk to him (answer the security questions). Dialogue: “Sadly his wife is no longer with us!” → “He loves worm holes” → “Anita”.
Talk to Anita in the house west of the Grand Tree; she gives you a key.
Search the chest in Glough's house with the key and take the invasion plans (finish the dialogue).
Take the invasion plans to King Narnode in the Grand Tree.
Place the twigs to spell 'TUZO' in the watchtower in Glough's house. Return to King Narnode if you lost any. If your Agility is below 25, eat a summer pie.
Go down the trapdoor. Be prepared for the fight against a Black demon (level 172).
Kill the black demon. Stand just north of the stairs and the demon gets stuck behind the rocks; use magic, ranged or a halberd for up to 10 minutes.
Talk to King Narnode deeper in the cave (finish the dialogue).
Search the roots under the Grand Tree until you find the last daconia rock. If you lose the rock, it will be in the same root again.
Give the daconia rock to King Narnode under the Grand Tree to finish the quest.

Take the panning tray.

Run north to the female student with blonde hair and pigtails on the north-west end of the dig and give her the "teddy" by talking to her twice.
Run east to the student with a beard and a reddish-orange shirt and give him the Special cup by talking to him twice.
Run south to the student in a green shirt and give him the Animal skull by talking to him twice.
